'''S7-U44''' is a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] active during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A heavily customized [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that had a red hull on its head and hands, and a heavily customized body patterned after a tuxedo, it frequently set up shop in a [[Tent/Legends|tent]] directly northeast of the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] at [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], as well as at [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] a short distance away from a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].

==Behind the scenes==
S7-U44 is a character introduced in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' Update 13, where it sold wares in exchange for tokens awarded during the Chronicles missions.
